558def _mongo_repair_duplicate_posters(*, mongo_uri, database_name, collection_name, backup_dir):559    """Collapse duplicate normalized poster references, keeping the most recently returned document."""560    if MongoClient is None:561        raise RuntimeError("pymongo is not installed")562    client = MongoClient(563        mongo_uri or "mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/",564        serverSelectionTimeoutMS=2000,565        connectTimeoutMS=2000,566        socketTimeoutMS=5000,567    )568    try:569        client.admin.command("ping")570        collection = client[database_name or "store"][collection_name or "posters"]571        cursor = collection.find({})572        try:573            cursor = cursor.sort("_id", 1)574        except Exception:575            pass576        docs = list(cursor)577        groups = {}578        for doc in docs:579            ref = _poster_doc_ref(doc)580            if ref:581                groups.setdefault(ref, []).append(doc)582        duplicates = {ref: group for ref, group in groups.items() if len(group) > 1}583        if not duplicates:584            return {"duplicate_groups": 0, "removed": 0, "backup_path": ""}585        backup_path, _ = _mongo_backup_posters(collection, backup_dir, "pre-dedupe")586        removed = 0587        for ref, group in duplicates.items():588            keeper = group[-1]589            collection.update_one({"_id": keeper["_id"]}, {"$set": {"number": ref}})590            extras = [doc["_id"] for doc in group[:-1] if doc.get("_id") is not None]591            if extras:592                result = collection.delete_many({"_id": {"$in": extras}})593                removed += int(result.deleted_count)594        return {"duplicate_groups": len(duplicates), "removed": removed, "backup_path": str(backup_path)}595    finally:596        client.close()

518def _mongo_scan_poster_references(*, mongo_uri, database_name, collection_name):519    """Return a non-destructive identity audit for one poster Mongo collection."""520    if MongoClient is None:521        raise RuntimeError("pymongo is not installed")522    client = MongoClient(523        mongo_uri or "mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/",524        serverSelectionTimeoutMS=2000,525        connectTimeoutMS=2000,526        socketTimeoutMS=5000,527    )528    try:529        client.admin.command("ping")530        collection = client[database_name or "store"][collection_name or "posters"]531        docs = list(collection.find({}))532        groups = {}533        unkeyed = []534        for doc in docs:535            ref = _poster_doc_ref(doc)536            if ref:537                groups.setdefault(ref, []).append(doc)538            else:539                unkeyed.append(doc)540        duplicate_groups = {ref: group for ref, group in groups.items() if len(group) > 1}541        examples = sorted(542            ((ref, len(group)) for ref, group in duplicate_groups.items()),543            key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]),544        )[:20]545        return {546            "total_documents": len(docs),547            "keyed_documents": sum(len(group) for group in groups.values()),548            "unkeyed_documents": len(unkeyed),549            "unique_references": len(groups),550            "duplicate_groups": len(duplicate_groups),551            "extra_duplicate_documents": sum(len(group) - 1 for group in duplicate_groups.values()),552            "duplicate_examples": examples,553        }554    finally:555        client.close()

843    def _load_config(self):844        """Load Sidekick's independent application config."""845        if not self.config_path.exists():846            return847        try:848            data = json.loads(self.config_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))849            if isinstance(data, dict):850                self.config.update(data)851        except Exception as exc:852            messagebox.showwarning(853                SIDEKICK_TITLE,854                f"Could not read {self.config_path.name}.\n\n{exc}",855            )

3017    @staticmethod3018    def _mixed_number_key(value):3019        """Sort poster numbers numerically; keep numbered suffixes beside their base number."""3020        text = str(value or "").strip()3021        if not text:3022            return (2, 0, "")3023        try:3024            return (0, int(text), "")3025        except (TypeError, ValueError):3026            digits = []3027            for char in text:3028                if char.isdigit():3029                    digits.append(char)3030                else:3031                    break3032            if digits:3033                return (0, int("".join(digits)), text.casefold())3034            return (1, 0, text.casefold())

2743    @staticmethod2744    def _records_from_import_py(path):2745        """Read a top-level ``posters = [...]`` dataset without executing the Python file."""2746        source = Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")2747        tree = ast.parse(source, filename=str(path))2748        posters_value = None2749        for node in tree.body:2750            if isinstance(node, (ast.Assign, ast.AnnAssign)):2751                targets = node.targets if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) else [node.target]2752                if any(isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == "posters" for target in targets):2753                    posters_value = node.value2754                    break2755        if posters_value is None:2756            raise ValueError("Python file does not contain a top-level posters = [...] dataset.")2757        try:2758            data = ast.literal_eval(posters_value)2759        except Exception as exc:2760            raise ValueError(f"The posters dataset must contain literal Python data only: {exc}") from exc2761        return ImageSidekick._records_from_import_json(data)

2527    def _redraw_poster_design_previews(self):2528        """Draw fixed previous/current/next regions; image sizes cannot change layout."""2529        canvas = getattr(self, "poster_design_preview_canvas", None)2530        if canvas is None:2531            return25322533        try:2534            canvas.delete("all")2535            canvas_w = max(canvas.winfo_width(), 50)2536            canvas_h = max(canvas.winfo_height(), 50)2537            gap = 825382539            # Fixed regions: small previous, large current, small next.2540            small_h = max(int(canvas_h * 0.18), 40)2541            middle_top = small_h + gap2542            middle_bottom = canvas_h - small_h - gap25432544            boxes = {2545                "prev": (0, 0, canvas_w, small_h, 0.62),2546                "current": (0, middle_top, canvas_w, middle_bottom, 1.0),2547                "next": (0, canvas_h - small_h, canvas_w, canvas_h, 0.62),2548            }25492550            self.poster_design_preview_refs = {}2551            for key in ("prev", "current", "next"):2552                source = self.poster_design_preview_sources.get(key)2553                if source is None:2554                    continue2555                x1, y1, x2, y2, width_fraction = boxes[key]2556                box_w = max(int((x2 - x1) * width_fraction) - 2, 20)2557                box_h = max((y2 - y1) - 4, 20)2558                img = source.copy()2559                img.thumbnail((box_w, box_h), Image.LANCZOS)2560                ref = ImageTk.PhotoImage(img)2561                self.poster_design_preview_refs[key] = ref2562                canvas.create_image(2563                    (x1 + x2) // 2,2564                    (y1 + y2) // 2,2565                    image=ref,2566                    anchor="center"2567                )2568        except Exception:2569            pass

2837    def repair_duplicate_posters(self):2838        """Audit then back up and collapse duplicate normalized poster references."""2839        db_name = self.mongo_database_var.get().strip() or "store"2840        coll_name = self.poster_collection_var.get().strip() or "posters"2841        target = f"{db_name}.{coll_name}"2842        uri = self.mongo_uri_var.get().strip() or "mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/"2843        try:2844            audit = _mongo_scan_poster_references(mongo_uri=uri, database_name=db_name, collection_name=coll_name)2845        except Exception as exc:2846            messagebox.showerror(SIDEKICK_TITLE, f"Could not scan {target}.\n\n{exc}")2847            return2848        audit_text = (2849            f"Target: {target}\nMongo documents: {audit['total_documents']}\n"2850            f"Documents with poster reference: {audit['keyed_documents']}\n"2851            f"Unique poster references: {audit['unique_references']}\n"2852            f"Duplicate reference groups: {audit['duplicate_groups']}\n"2853            f"Extra duplicate documents: {audit['extra_duplicate_documents']}\n"2854            f"Documents with no recognised reference: {audit['unkeyed_documents']}"2855        )2856        self.poster_data_log_var.set(f"Scan {target}: {audit['total_documents']} docs / {audit['duplicate_groups']} duplicate groups")2857        if audit["duplicate_groups"] == 0:2858            messagebox.showinfo(SIDEKICK_TITLE, "No duplicate poster references were found.\n\n" + audit_text + "\n\nCompare the Mongo document count with Compass.")2859            return2860        examples = ", ".join(f"{ref} x{count}" for ref, count in audit.get("duplicate_examples", [])[:10])2861        prompt = audit_text + (f"\n\nExamples: {examples}" if examples else "") + "\n\nRepair now? A complete JSON backup is written first."2862        if not messagebox.askyesno(SIDEKICK_TITLE, prompt):2863            return2864        try:2865            stats = _mongo_repair_duplicate_posters(2866                mongo_uri=uri, database_name=db_name, collection_name=coll_name,2867                backup_dir=self._poster_backup_dir(create=True),2868            )2869        except Exception as exc:2870            messagebox.showerror(SIDEKICK_TITLE, f"Duplicate repair failed.\n\n{exc}")2871            return2872        self.poster_source_var.set("mongodb")2873        self.save_config(); self.refresh_poster_designs()2874        msg = f"{target}: {stats['duplicate_groups']} duplicate group(s); {stats['removed']} document(s) removed"2875        if stats.get("backup_path"):2876            msg += f"\n\nSafety backup:\n{stats['backup_path']}"2877        self.poster_data_log_var.set(msg.splitlines()[0])2878        messagebox.showinfo(SIDEKICK_TITLE, msg)
